classificationRules.IMPLEMENTED: Source code exists, compiles, and provides full or partial mathematical execution.
classificationRules.TESTED: Automated regression or unit tests execute without runtime crash or unhandled exceptions.
classificationRules.INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED: Numerical outputs reconciled against independent recalculation, analytical references, or separate solvers.
classificationRules.QUALIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE: Formally certified through closed gate evidence with explicit, verified boundaries of applicability.

capabilities.name: 3D Incompressible FVM SIMPLE Navier-Stokes Solver
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Incompressible steady-state single-phase flow, Re <= 2e5, structured/block hex FVM mesh, First Order Upwind / Central Difference. Strict mass conservation <= 1.0%.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Industrial CFD Workflow Orchestrator
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Orchestrates Pre-Flight Risk Check, Mesh Quality Diagnostics, Boundary Condition Validation, Dynamic Relaxation, Divergence Backtracking Recovery, and Canonical Hashing.

capabilities.name: Standard k-epsilon Turbulence Model
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Fully developed channel, pipe, and high-Reynolds free-shear flows with equilibrium boundary layers. Standard wall functions (y+ > 30).

capabilities.name: Menter SST k-omega Turbulence Model
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Aerodynamic flows with adverse pressure gradients and boundary layer separation. Requires resolved near-wall mesh (y+ ~ 1-5) or scalable wall treatment.

capabilities.name: Grid Convergence Index (GCI) Analysis Engine
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Three geometrically similar grid levels with refinement ratio r >= 1.25. Enforces ASME V&V 20-2009 strict contract for monotonic convergence.

capabilities.name: Global & Local Boundary Mass Balance Auditor
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: Evaluates net face-by-face mass flux over all boundary patches with strict 0.0000% discrepancy against post-solution boundary integration.

capabilities.name: Compressible Shock Capturing Engine
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY. 1D axial algebraic shock sensor. Not integrated with 3D FVM cell-face flux splitting or conservative energy equations. Strictly non-production.

capabilities.name: Smagorinsky-Lilly LES Turbulence Model
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY. Subgrid-scale model in turbulence registry; pending time-accurate unsteady Navier-Stokes solver qualification.

capabilities.name: Two-Way Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) Coupling Engine
capabilities.declaredLimitsOfUse: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY. Boundary stress interpolation to structural meshes; reserved for upcoming SECP-ENGINE-QUALIFICATION-002 campaign.
